scope: Retrospective descriptive scoring of fixed saved predictions, no new model call or training. Q2 uses corrected decimal labels; TRAIN and Q1 use original label receipts. All periods are reused development data.
method: For each 1..60 minute horizon, include observed nonzero outcomes matured before the relevant cutoff; predict UP iff logit > 0, otherwise DOWN; compute integer counts, accuracy, preselected always-LONG reference and independent rank-sum AUC. TRAIN before/after rows and targets must match exactly.
limits: The 256 TRAIN rows are a small diagnostic sample. Q2 is a fixed one-in-ten-batch subset of a previously reused development period. No threshold tuning, causal attribution, unseen generalization or economic/trading claim.
